in_marathi.name: Agraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Agraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Agraj is a Sanskrit name derived from 'agra' meaning 'foremost' and 'jaya' meaning 'victory'. This name is given to a boy symbolizing his position as the foremost victor in the universe.
